## Review checklist

- [ ] Target is `master`; changes are on a separate branch.
- [ ] Requirement status reflects actual evidence; mocks are identified.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data or generated outputs are committed.
- [ ] Unrun checks and blockers are disclosed.
- [ ] CI cost and publication changes are explicitly scoped (or absent).
